items.rationale: Covered under 2.3.3 as a surge-damaged appliance; no surge protector was fitted, so indemnity is halved. Reference cases put the halved speaker at about 250-315.
The TV was damaged and is covered, but 7.1.9 limits it to a standard 55-inch LED equivalent (about 650-700), then 2.3.3 halves it for the missing surge protector.
No physical damage to the cables is established (4.2.4, 7.1.5); the reference case gave near zero. If paid, it would be a low halved amount.
A passive bracket cannot be surge damaged, so it is not an affected item under 4.2.4 and 7.1.5; the reference case gave near zero.
A battery-powered remote is not connected to the mains and no damage is established (4.2.4); at most it is an accessory of the TV at a halved amount.
The console was switched off and unplugged in a cupboard, so the surge did not affect it; excluded under 4.2.4, 4.3(d) and 7.1.5.
Delivery of replacement property is expressly not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b).
Fitting and setting up replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(c).
Under 11.2 this invoice relates to a service and liability arrangement, excluded by 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(e)/(f); the reference cases gave near zero.

items.description: Wiring safety check of distribution board
items.rationale: An inspection of undamaged wiring is not a repair cost (7.1.5, 7.1.8(a)/(f), 3.1.5); the reference case gave near zero.
An attendance charge on an invoice with no indemnifiable work is itself not indemnifiable under 7.1.8(d).
